name: National Grid (Niagara Mohawk Power Corp.) - Upstate New York
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public nationalgridus.com pages only (no sign-in). Online bank payments need an online profile; card and digital-wallet payments go through Speedpay with fees 'starting at $1.85' for residential customers (the exact fee depends on the payment, so $1.85 is modelled as the card fee and the wording is kept in help). Whether Speedpay card payments need a profile is not stated; Speedpay is linked from the public pay page without sign-in, so guest pay is modelled as card-only (evidence inferred). Automated Payments are bank-only; amount options are full bill, a maximum amount, or a fixed amount (weekly, bi-weekly or monthly); full and fixed are modelled (maximum and non-monthly schedules cannot be expressed). Full/maximum plans pay on the due date. Paperless billing gives a monthly on-bill credit whose amount is not stated. Viewing a paperless bill from email requires two-step authentication; sign-in MFA is not described, so family default. Stop service is online after signing in, with 5-7 days' notice. The same National Grid portal also serves the Metro NY gas dossier (gas category).

guest_pay.note: Card and digital wallet payments are made through Speedpay; fees apply.

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Pay from a checking or savings account online once you have an online profile, or schedule a bank payment in the app. Bank payments are free.
Credit and debit cards and digital wallets (Venmo, PayPal, Google Pay, Apple Pay) are processed by Speedpay. Fees start at $1.85 for residential customers.

By phone, call 1-800-642-4272 with your 10-digit account number to pay from a bank account. By mail, make your check payable to National Grid and send it to P.O. Box 371376, Pittsburgh, PA 15250-7376. You can also pay at an authorized payment location.

help.title: Automated Payments
paragraphs: Automated Payments draft your bank account automatically; card payments are not part of this program.

Choose the full bill amount, a maximum amount, or a fixed amount. Full and maximum plans pay once per billing period on the due date and run until you cancel or reach an optional end date. Fixed-amount plans can run weekly, every two weeks or monthly from a start date you pick and end on the date you select.
The first payment can go out as soon as the day after you set up the plan.
steps: Choose the amount option and your bank account.

help.title: Paperless Billing
paragraphs: Go paperless from My Account to get your bill electronically instead of by mail, with a monthly on-bill credit. Have your account number from a recent bill ready if you are not registered yet.
Payment reminders can come by email, text or both; set them under Notification Preferences.

help.title: Help paying your bill
paragraphs: More Time to Pay: payment extensions when you need extra time on a gas or electric bill.
Budget Plan: spreads your yearly energy cost over 12 even monthly charges.

Energy Affordability Program (EAP) gives monthly bill credits to households that meet HEAP guidelines; the Enhanced EAP offers income-based discounts to customers who do not qualify for EAP. Grants may be available through HEAP, Temporary Assistance and Care & Share.
Homes with seriously ill or life-support residents can get protection from shutoff for nonpayment.

help.title: Stop service
paragraphs: Choose Stop Service and sign in to request a stop date. Give 5 to 7 days' notice, because a crew member visits to turn service off.
steps: Pick a stop date at least 5-7 days out.

help.title: Frequently asked questions
paragraphs: Customer service is available Monday through Friday, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., at 1-800-642-4272.
Automated Payments keep running until you cancel them or reach the end date you set.
